बॉलीवुड में करवा चौथ की धूम मची हुई है और परिणीति चोपड़ा ने तो इस बार सबसे अलग ही अंदाज दिखा दिया! ✈️❤️

अभिनेत्री परिणीति चोपड़ा ने गुरुवार को अपने पति और राजनेता राघव चड्ढा के साथ बेहद अनोखे अंदाज में करवा चौथ का त्यौहार मनाया। दोनों ने हवा में 35,000 feet की ऊंचाई पर plane के अंदर ही चांद देखकर अपना व्रत पूरा किया।

सोशल मीडिया पर शेयर किए गए video में परिणीति ट्रेडिशनल सूट पहने और सिंदूर लगाए नजर आ रही हैं। प्लेन में चांद देखने के बाद राघव ने उन्हें अपने हाथों से पानी और खाना खिलाया। परिणीति ने राघव की तारीफ करते हुए लिखा कि वह उनके सारे सपने पूरे करते हैं।

इस लम्हे ने फैंस को प्रियंका चोपड़ा के उस बयान की याद दिला दी, जब Nick Jonas उन्हें भी चांद देखने के लिए plane से बादलों के ऊपर ले गए थे।

बता दें कि परिणीति और राघव ने 24 September 2023 को उदयपुर में शादी की थी और 19 October 2025 को दोनों एक बेटे के माता-पिता बने हैं।

क्या आपने भी कभी करवा चौथ का ऐसा अनोखा सेलिब्रेशन देखा है? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताइए! 👇✨

ctx.title: Parineeti Chopra ends Karwa Chauth fast at 35,000 feet, shares video from plane with Raghav Chadha: ‘You make all my dreams come true'
ctx.summary: Parineeti Chopra shared a video of herself and husband Raghav Chadha celebrating Karwa Chauth aboard a flight.
ctx.text:
Several Bollywood celebrities celebrated Karwa Chauth on Thursday and shared glimpses of their celebrations on social media. Actor Parineeti Chopra marked the festival in a special way this year, showing that distance and circumstances cannot come in the way of traditions. The actor shared a video from a flight, giving fans a glimpse of how she celebrated the festival with her husband, politician Raghav Chadha , at 35,000 feet.
Taking to Instagram on Thursday, Parineeti shared a video featuring herself and Raghav inside the plane. The couple were seen spotting the moon before Parineeti broke her fast mid-air. Raghav fed her water and food as she completed the ritual. Sharing the video, Parineeti wrote, “Karwa chauth is wherever we are. Even if its at 35000 feet! 🤗🥰” Praising her husband, she added, “You make all my dreams come true Ragaji. The best man, the best human, the best boii." The actor was seen wearing a traditional suit and flaunting her sindoor as she celebrated the festival.
A post shared by Parineeti Chopra (@parineetichopra)
The video reminded several fans of Priyanka Chopra's Karwa Chauth anecdote. During an appearance on The Kapil Sharma Show in 2025, Priyanka revealed that her husband, Nick Jonas, had taken her on a plane above the clouds to help her break her Karwa Chauth fast when the moon was not visible. She said, "We’ve tried to spot the moon in the strangest places. Once, we were at a stadium where he was doing a show, and the moon just wouldn’t appear. There were clouds, and rain was about to start. Around 60–70 thousand people were present and the show kept going on. We waited till 10 pm, then 11 pm, and still the moon wasn’t visible. Want to hear something romantic? He finally took me up in a plane, above the clouds, and then I broke my fast after seeing the moon."
Parineeti and Raghav got engaged on May 13, 2023, at Kapurthala House in New Delhi, in an intimate ceremony attended by family members and close friends. The couple tied the knot on September 24, 2023, at The Leela Palace in Udaipur, Rajasthan, in the presence of their family members and close friends.
Parineeti opted for an elegant pink outfit for her wedding, while Raghav complemented her in an ivory ensemble. Several political leaders and celebrities attended the celebrations, making it a much-talked-about wedding. The couple embraced parenthood with the arrival of their first child, a baby boy, on October 19, 2025.
